title: Processing a recording into its asset, a seekable file, its audio, a manifest and chapters

tasks.title: The processing queue and job, byte-range media, the manifest endpoint, ffmpeg in the image and in CI

acs.text: WHEN a recording is finished (or finalised after its uploads stopped) THE SYSTEM SHALL queue it for processing once; it SHALL stay playable from its raw chunks until processing is done

WHEN a queued recording is processed THE SYSTEM SHALL write, in the object store beside it, `media.webm` (the raw chunks remuxed without re-encoding, with a duration and a seek index), `audio.m4a` (its audio), `timeline.json` (the reader timeline) and last `manifest.json` (each file's size and SHA-256, the duration, whether the leader's camera was ever on, the chapters), mark it done, and remove its raw chunks
THE SYSTEM SHALL make a chapter {t, ref, heRef} of each place the leader's text stayed, from the timeline's summary slice, and drop a place the leader left within 3 seconds

WHEN anyone who may read a processed recording asks for its media with a byte range THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 206 with that range (at most 8 MB per answer) and `Content-Range`, 416 for a range outside the file, and the whole file without a range

WHEN processing runs twice for one recording THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the same files; WHEN it fails THE SYSTEM SHALL try again after a wait, and after 3 failed tries mark it failed, keeping its raw chunks so it still plays
THE SYSTEM SHALL have ffmpeg in the server image, and start the processing worker with the server (from its health check), so work left by a restart is picked up
